Tome of Ruin: The Word Dungeon

name: Tome of Ruin: The Word Dungeon
storyline: A hero who believes they are trapped in a dream searches for a way out of a mysterious, dangerous world. Not knowing why they are there, they fight to survive, and in this merciless world their only weapon is words. The path leads down through 8 dungeons and 200 floors to the Book of Evil.
summary: Tome of Ruin: The Word Dungeon is a dark fantasy RPG where every word is a weapon. Type words to strike, chase five-star loot through 8 dungeons and 200 floors, earn your class promotion, hunt wanted outlaws and face the Book of Evil. It is not a deckbuilder: it is a full RPG with two heroes, 12 socket slots, enchanting, an Arena and Hardcore mode. Word lists in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and German.
